-You can make an edit at any time by clicking on "My Account" and "All Postings". Next to the listing you want to edit,

-Your dashboard will also show you if your item is receiving interest. The "eye" icon represents the number of people 
who have clicked on your item, and the cart shows how many people have added it to their cart. 
-When a buyer purchases your item, you'll receive both an e-mail and a text message from us. Make sure to confirm 
within 24 hours!
